chapters.reason: The paper introduces two distinct control tokens (<memory> and <reason>) to disentangle and separately control memory retrieval and reasoning steps, which directly matches the 'multiple distinct control signals' and 'finer-grained control' description of multi_type_signal.

The method operates by inserting special tokens (<memory> and <reason>) into the generation process to steer the model's behavior, aligning with the token_level description of manipulating individual tokens to guide reasoning.

The paradigm aims to make the internal decision-making process (separating knowledge retrieval from reasoning) more explicit and interpretable, which relates to regulating reasoning based on the model's internal states, though the primary mechanism is token-based.
